title: From Attack Surface to Defense Architecture: Compositional Security for Agentic Coding Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2611.13960v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI coding harnesses couple language models to shells, filesystems, and network sockets, turning the harness into an automated Living-off-the-Land (LotL) platform: once an adversary injects instructions into retrieved content, dual-use binaries such as bash, curl, and find become the payload. We argue that security in agentic systems is a structural property of the cognitive architecture and permission composition rather than an emergent property of individual models. Static regex blacklists miss structural evasions, whereas LLM-as-a-Judge guardrails incur high latency while over-blocking benign work.   We present ActiveSecHarness, a neurosymbolic reference-monitor architecture built around Separation of Intelligence and Authority. It combines (1) Macaroon-inspired HMAC capability tokens across four Trust and Authority Rings, (2) a 2D product taint lattice $\mathcal{L} = \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{trust}} \times \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sens}}$ a

translated_title: 从攻击面到防御架构：面向智能体编程工具的组合式安全
translated_abstract: AI编程工具将语言模型与shell、文件系统和网络套接字耦合在一起，使该工具本身成为一个自动化的“就地取材”式攻击平台：一旦对手将指令注入到检索到的内容中，bash、curl和find等双用途二进制程序就会成为攻击载荷。我们主张，智能体系统的安全性是认知架构与权限组合的结构性属性，而非单个模型的涌现属性。静态正则表达式黑名单无法检测结构性规避手段，而基于LLM-as-a-Judge的防护栏不仅延迟高，还会过度拦截良性任务。我们提出了ActiveSecHarness，一个围绕“智能与权限分离”原则构建的神经符号参考监控器架构。它结合了：(1) 跨越四个信任与权限环的、受Macaroon启发的HMAC能力令牌；(2) 一个二维乘积污染格 L = L_trust × L_sens…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ActiveSecHarness——一种基于“智能与权限分离”原则的神经符号参考监控器架构，通过HMAC能力令牌与二维污染格为AI编程智能体提供结构性的组合式安全防御。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ActiveSecHarness, a neurosymbolic reference-monitor architecture built on the Separation of Intelligence and Authority, which combines HMAC capability tokens and a 2D taint lattice to provide compositional, structural security for agentic coding harnesses.
